description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


📖 Read the announcement blog post: https://tabularis.dev/blog/v0230-postgres-plugin-migration-sql-files-storage-location?utm_src=github-release
See the assets below to download this version and install.
What's Changed
- feat: open, edit and save SQL files in editor tabs by @debba in #706
- fix: rank tables first and tighten search in the quick navigator by @debba in #703
- chore(deps): bump swatinem/rust-cache from 2.9.1 to 2.9.2 by @dependabot[bot] in #664
- chore(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6.1.0 to 7.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in #661
- chore(deps): bump actions/cache from 4 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in #663
- chore(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in #662
- Guard shortcuts during text composition by @DhruvShah-Dev in #656
- feat(explain): let plugins register their own EXPLAIN parsers by @debba in #688
- fix: preserve unknown connection fields by @atirna in #708
- Fix PostgreSQL pool size setting for pgBouncer by @DhruvShah-Dev in #681
- feat: custom storage location for connections and app data by @debba in #707
- ci: add label-driven PR preview builds by @debba in #705
- chore(skills): add Codex metadata for tabularis-pr-review and drop stray .codex file by @debba in #730
- fix(dump): escape JSON columns and backslashes per dialect by @soliloquist in #720
- fix(test): bind storage globals to the jsdom environment by @be-student in #719
- Fix lost keystrokes in the SQL editor: backward selection on WebKit and debounce race by @debba in #732
- Implement builtin PostgreSQL -> plugin migration flow by @aesslinger in #685
New Contributors
- @atirna made their first contribution in #708
- @soliloquist made their first contribution in #720
- @be-student made their first contribution in #719
